card.name: Numbering in section and unit references
card.fires_on: Digits and spaces inside numbered references, such as table numbers, section cross-references like (5.1, 5.2), and the 1.73 m2 in eGFR units. It fires at the point just before the next number or decimal part.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: Space or digit inside a list of table or section numbers in parentheses or after 'Table'.

modes.label: Body surface area unit
modes.description: The digit 1 in mL/min/1.73 m2 after eGFR or creatinine clearance.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit within a numbered section heading or cross-reference such as 12.3.

card.writes: It adds little clear output, perhaps nudging toward the next item in a sequence.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers inside table, section and kidney-function unit references, just before the next number.
